text:
lina_support: Customer reports sustained 429s from their Dedicated pool during nightly DB backups (approx 00:30-01:15 UTC). Tenant acme-uk-prod. P50 latency also increased. Any obvious suspects? :eyes:

james_infra: Which pool and do we have the tenant quota snapshot/logs for that window? Also any recent plan or quota changes?

lina_support: Pool is `dedicated-eu-03`. They sent a curl repro hitting the tenant-scoped endpoint:

```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \\n  -d '{"input":"bulk backup test"}' \\n  https://dedicated-eu-03.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?tenant=acme-uk-prod
```

They said errors start ~00:32 UTC and kept returning 429s for ~40m.

omar_sre: I saw alerts from that pool too. Autoscaler looked healthy but queue rejects spiked. My first thought: per-tenant emergency ceiling kicked in and we started rejecting instead of queuing because of a cooldown/hysteresis mismatch.

eve_prod: Pulled the quota docs for acme-uk-prod — something looks off in the quota schedule applied at midnight. snippet from our config store:

```
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-uk-prod",
  "per_tenant_hourly_ceiling": 480000,
  "pacing_window_seconds": 3600,
  "cooldown_seconds": 14400,  // unexpectedly long cooldown
  "burst_capacity": 400
}
```

If cooldown_seconds >> pacing_window_seconds, a big overnight spike can blow the hourly budget and then prevent recovery for hours.

james_infra: quota-bot shows a policy migration rolled at 23:55 last night that adjusted ceilings for several tenants as part of the plan-migrate rollout. Looks like acme got the conservative multiplier (x0.2) due to a mapping issue.

quota-bot: per-tenant-hourly-ceiling updated for acme-uk-prod by eve_prod at 2026-03-16T23:55Z (old: 240000, new: 480000, applied-multiplier: 0.2).

lina_support: Can we repro quickly by replaying a representative burst? I can ask customer for a captured request trace but we can simulate with ab/vegeta against dedicated-eu-03 under the tenant header.

omar_sre: Yes — replay will show behaviour. Quick mitigation: temporarily bump acme-uk-prod ceiling and reduce cooldown to let autoscaler and KV cache handle more sustained volume. I'll prepare a canary change to increase ceiling to 1M for next 30m and set cooldown_seconds=3600.

eve_prod: Applying change to acme-uk-prod ceiling and cooldown now in config store (will patch via infra pipeline). I'll post the patch ID and monitor metrics. :thumbsup:

lina_support: Thanks — I'll message the customer with ETA and ask them to hold off heavy backups for 1 hour if possible.

james_infra: After we stabilize, we should add a rule to the plan-migrate script to prevent multiplier applying to tenants with scheduled backup windows (or detect long cooldowns). Filing a follow-up ticket. :memo:

omar_sre: Agreed. Also adding an alert to detect prolonged rejection windows (>5m) tied to per-tenant ceilings so we can auto-escalate before customer impact.

eve_prod: Patch applied: config-patch-7894. Monitoring band shows 429 rate falling and latency returning to baseline. Updating incident notes. :white_check_mark:
